im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
H,W,_=im.shape
# coarse ascii: 64x36 grid, label dominant hue
small = np.array(Image.fromarray(im).resize((86,40), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR))
chars=' .:-=+*#%@'
for row in small:
    line=''
    for r,g,b in row:
        # classify
        if b>r+25 and b>g+10: c='B'
        elif r>120 and g>110 and b<90 and abs(int(r)-int(g))<60: c='Y' if r>150 else 'y'
        elif r>g+20 and r>b+20: c='R'
        elif r<40 and g<40 and b<40: c='#'
        elif r>180 and g>160 and b>120: c='.'  # light wood
        else:
            lum=(int(r)+int(g)+int(b))//3
            c=chars[min(9,lum*10//256)]
        line+=c
    print(line)
